status: Open to senior roles · Toronto / remote

hero.headline: Software that *thinks ahead*.
hero.subline: Senior backend engineer building payments infrastructure, identity and the AI-native workflows that make teams ship faster.

thesis: Most software still runs on yesterday's assumptions. I build for the version where AI is a teammate, not a feature, and where the boring parts never break.

projects.title: Credit card transaction workflow
projects.summary: The transaction processing path for the Tims Financial credit card, from backend architecture through frontend integration.

projects.title: Architecture assistant on Bedrock
projects.summary: An LLM assistant built on Amazon Bedrock flows that answered engineers' questions about the team's existing AWS architecture.

projects.title: Google Pay integration
projects.summary: Redesigned and rebuilt the Google Pay flow as a reusable component across the app.

projects.title: Account linking and rewards
projects.summary: OIDC account linking and rewards earning across two loyalty programs, with 200,000 users linked in launch week.

projects.title: Facebook Marketplace chatbot
projects.summary: Processes over 1,000,000 listings daily, generating 10,000+ leads and an estimated $26M in added yearly revenue.

projects.title: Kite jump tracker
projects.summary: Jump height from a watch's FIT files, with an iPhone helper to review every session.

principles.title: Design the failure path first
principles.body: In payments the happy path is the easy part. Retries, reversals and reconciliation get designed before the demo does.

principles.title: AI drafts, tests decide
principles.body: Agents are part of my daily loop for exploring, scaffolding and reviewing. Nothing merges on vibes; everything merges on evidence.

principles.title: Ship the boring parts brilliantly
principles.body: Auth flows, idempotency keys, migrations. The unglamorous work is where reliability lives.

principles.title: Leave the system clearer than you found it
principles.body: Every integration I touch should be easier for the next engineer to reuse, the way the Google Pay flow became a shared component.

principles.title: Think in years, ship in days
principles.body: Pick the architecture that survives the next three launches, then deliver it in small pieces that each go live.

contact.headline: Let's build what's next.
contact.body: Hiring for a senior engineer who treats AI as a teammate and payments as a craft? I'd like to hear about it.
